## Abstract

Where ecologically unequal exchange touches the ground, it is often contested. This first
part of the session picks up where [Free trade — blessing or curse?](s_05_Trade.html) (Session 5)
ended. It introduces **ecological distribution conflicts** and the **environmentalism of the
poor**, presents the **Environmental Justice Atlas (EJAtlas)**, and offers a structured way
of analysing a single conflict — illustrated with lithium mining in the Salar de Atacama,
Chile. In the group work, you apply it to a conflict in your country.
